text:
This afternoon, the departure team read your report with care and understands that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during travel, along with the concern that the response you received did not reflect the seriousness of the situation.

We are sorry that this experience left you worried. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and any report involving a companion animal is reviewed as a welfare matter, not as a routine service issue. The departure team has already asked a safety coordinator to review the handling steps, the handoff points, and the condition of the travel area used for the animal. We also want to reassure you that trained staff are expected to give each animal patient attention and to keep transport conditions calm, secure, and suitable for the animal's needs.

<<FACT F120>> The review is focused on what happened, how the concern was recorded, and whether any prevention step should be strengthened before future travel. If a problem is confirmed, the matter will be referred through the proper safety channel so that corrective action can be taken. If you have photos, carrier notes, or any other supporting details, please send them so the review can be completed with more confidence and care.

We regret any distress this caused to you and to your animal. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is committed to a measured response, a respectful tone, and a safer process for every traveler who entrusts Aurelia Skyways with an animal. We appreciate you bringing the issue forward and giving us the chance to review it with the seriousness it deserves.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
